artworks.title: Roman Buildings with an Open Shed
artworks.description: The image depicts a complex architectural scene viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The composition contains buildings with columns, arches, and statues. The artistic style features loose lines and hatching, creating a textured and impressionistic quality. The grayscale palette emphasizes form and structure.

artworks.title: Rocklined Beach with Distant Boats
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with graphite and gray wash

artworks.title: Market Scene with a Fantastic Sculpture
artworks.medium: pen and black and brown ink with gray and brown wash and watercolor, heightened with white gouache, over traces of graphite and traces of black chalk on laid paper, with the remains of a framing line in brown ink
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bustling marketplace with various animals and goods. The artwork depicts a lively market scene with detailed depictions of livestock, produce, and architectural elements in the background. The scene is arranged under large drapes.

artworks.title: View of Ceriana
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite
artworks.description: The view in the drawing is elevated looking towards a hillside town nestled amidst trees and rocky terrain. The horizon is high with the townscape, including a church tower sitting on it. The brushstrokes are created using sharp lines and shading, exhibiting a sketch-like quality capturing the trees and town structures with detailed linear strokes. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting primarily of sepia and black tones. Closest are rocky outcrops and sparse trees forming a natural frame, while beyond, the hillside is densely filled with trees and residential structures cascading down the slope towards the valley.

artworks.title: Pagoda Flowers and Roses
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows several broad fern-like leaves, clusters of berries, and a thin branched line connecting them. The color palette consists of grayscale tones with hints of reddish-brown. The fern-like patterns emerge from the top left and top center, descending diagonally to the right. In the center, there is a distinct sprig of fern set in a V shape. Smaller floral designs are visible in the bottom right and left corners, and there is a singular insect floating closer to the left edge.

artworks.title: Bamboo Flowers and Cactus
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image features intricate and abstract shapes and lines. The predominant forms resemble curved, spiky structures with a central circular pattern. They have long, slender appendages extending from them. Additionally, there are multiple elongated, segmented forms clustered together, containing fine hair-like projections. These configurations might evoke underwater organisms or insects, dotted across the composition in an organized manner. Slight botanical elements can also be discerned.

artworks.title: Trumpet Flowers and Daisies
artworks.medium: black and red chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: Large floral designs with detailed petals, clusters of berries, branches and leaves, a butterfly, and a dragonfly are depicted in this image. The color palette is mainly monochrome with subtle soft pink accents. Flowers, branches, and berries are prominent in the upper left and center, while a butterfly is in the upper right. Branches with elongated leaves run from the top right to the bottom center, where the dragonfly is located in the lower left corner among downward-facing flared elements. The square background is framed by lighter triangular corners.

artworks.title: Rocky Landscape with a Rustic House
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with hills and vegetation. A small house is visible in the middle-right area. The artwork features detailed ink drawings with fluid lines and crosshatching for texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with sepia tones on a creamy paper background. Shrubbery and rocks are depicted in the foreground, leading to hills in the distance where the house is nestled among trees. The sky is clear above the trees and house.

artworks.title: Mawddach Falls near Dolgelly
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 33.9 x 47 cm (13 3/8 x 18 1/2 in.)
support: 42.3 x 55.9 cm (16 5/8 x 22 in.)
artworks.description: This image depicts a cascading waterfall surrounded by rocky terrain. The waterfall flows from a high point, with dense woods and rock formations in the background. The painting shows intricate brushstrokes capturing rock textures and foliage details. The color scheme is gray, blue, and white, creating a serene atmosphere. Boulders in the foreground lead the viewer's eye towards the waterfall, with a river or stream at its base. A small figure near the water emphasizes the scale of the scene. Trees in the distance frame the image, featuring hints of green and brown.

artworks.title: Caritas (Charity)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on thin laid paper [second edition impression probably printed circa 1920-1930]
artworks.description: The image is an etching of an elderly man's upper body. The man is hunched, with his head slightly turned. He has a long beard, deeply set eyes, gray hair mostly covered by a hood, and is wearing a robe. He is holding a staff or cane. In the background, there is a textured, cross-hatched pattern. The word "CARI" is inscribed in the upper left corner of the etching.

artworks.title: Imaginary Port Scene
artworks.description: The image shows a low-angle view of a grand architectural setting with a large ship partially visible to the left. The horizon is high, showcasing the tops of intricately designed buildings with classical columns and sculptural decorations. The etching features detailed line work, capturing the textures of the architecture and ship sails. The color scheme is monochromatic, with sepia tones emphasizing antiquity. The ship's ornate stern and rigging are prominent, while the distant buildings convey scale and grandeur. The sky is simple, directing focus to the structures.

artworks.title: Funeral Scene in Imaginary Architecture
artworks.description: This drawing features classical architecture with massive Corinthian columns and intricate decorations. A group of figures is depicted in a procession, carrying something significant. The composition includes detailed arches and an elaborate entablature, creating a grand atmosphere. The image includes strong lines and shadows, emphasizing depth and perspective.

artworks.title: Diana at the Bath
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 17.8 x 16 cm (7 x 6 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a fabric-covered surface, facing slightly to the left. One arm is extended to hold onto a draped piece of cloth. The person's head is turned forward, with a calm expression, soft eyes, and a gentle smile. Their hair is styled close to the scalp. The individual is unclothed, with detailed shading defining their form and the surrounding drapery. Folds of fabric drape around them, and there are intricate etchings of foliage in the background.

artworks.title: Diogenes Casting away his Bowl
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 45.3 x 27.2 cm (17 13/16 x 10 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an outdoor setting surrounded by trees. The scene features individuals interacting under tall, leafy trees. The trees have textured bark and branches stretching across the scene, with leaves adding depth. The foliage is rendered with fine lines, creating a lush background. The ground beneath the figures is depicted with foliage and rocks, adding texture to the environment. The intricate line work and careful depiction suggest a classic or historical narrative.

artworks.title: Plato's Cave
artworks.artist: Jan Pietersz Saenredam after Cornelis Cornelisz van Haarlem
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 33.7 x 45 cm (13 1/4 x 17 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a print of a detailed interior scene with people in a cave-like environment. There is a contrast between the illuminated faces of the people near the entrance on the left and the people clustered in the deeper, darker parts of the cave on the right. In the center of the cave, a low wall appears to extend, trapping the people on the right into a dark, confined area. On top of this wall are small statues of people in different positions holding different objects, like long horns or scepters. Some of the statues have large wings. These statues cast shadows on the wall to the far right. To the left of center, a hanging brazier casts light on the left side of the print, below which a group of men in robes seem to converse together. Behind them is the arched opening of the cave, and beyond it we can see three distant people standing together against a pale sky. There is Latin text above and below the print.

artworks.title: The Stoning of Saint Stephen
artworks.description: This is an image showing a central figure in elaborate robes raising its arms, surrounded by other figures in various poses. Above, there are floating figures in a heavenly tableau. The scene is detailed and shaded.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Two Beavers
artworks.description: The image shows a natural scene with various animals and plants seen from a low angle perspective. The horizon is low, with a sky filled with clouds above. In the background, mountains are visible, and trees create a barrier. The detailed etching style reveals intricate details in the foliage and animals. The monochromatic color palette accentuates light, shadow, and details with black and gray tones. Near the viewer are grasses, otter-like creatures by a stream, a turtle, and a snake in the dynamic landscape.

artworks.title: Marengo
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse standing on a piece of land with a body of water and a distant horizon. The scene captures a muscular, elegant horse at rest on a textured, grassy bank, with its mane and tail flowing softly. The landscape extends into a calm body of water beneath a vast, cloudy sky. The chiaroscuro contrasts and fine cross-hatching techniques highlight the details of the horse's anatomy and the serene atmosphere of the landscape. The drawing emphasizes the harmony between the horse and its surroundings.

artworks.title: A Baby in a Basket Outdoors (Couverture pour L'Album d'estampes originales)
artworks.description: The image features a collection of abstract shapes and lines with various colors and forms. The lettering is scattered and somewhat blurred, resembling faded paint or chalk on a wall. The word "album" stands out prominently, similar to what may be seen on a vintage music poster. The letters are integrated into an abstract, organic background with earthy tones, patches of green, and white. The word "originals" is faintly visible below, floating over a textured, brownish surface resembling stone or aged paper. The design conveys a blend of natural and human-made elements in an abstract and impressionistic style.

artworks.title: Shepherds Resting by a Stream
artworks.medium: gouache and pastel on prepared canvas
artworks.creditLine: Robert H. and Clarice Smith Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. The horizon line is high, showing rolling hills and an old structure on a hill to the left. Figures in rustic clothing tend to a flock of sheep amidst rocky terrain and lush greenery. Trees of varying heights and a waterfall in the middle add depth and movement to the scene. The color palette consists of soft earthy tones with a clear, pale blue sky and wispy clouds. The brushwork is skillful and blends elements seamlessly.

artworks.title: Allegory on the Turkish Wars
artworks.medium: pen and brown and black inks with watercolor over graphite on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene with a mythical element. The drawing depicts a chaotic battle scene filled with numerous figures, armed and in combat. One figure stands prominently in the center, gesturing. Another figure is clad in armor. A unique element in the drawing is the depiction of a goat riding a fish with a sprouting flower, positioned in the clouds above the battle. The composition is circular, drawn with light colors and fluid lines capturing movement and energy.

artworks.title: Figure Studies
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash heightened with white over black chalk
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures. One figure is standing on the left, displaying a muscular build and a strong stance. The figure on the right is kneeling and reaching upwards with their right arm. The sketch is done in a loose, gestural style with visible contours. The background is neutral, highlighting the interaction between the two figures.

artworks.title: Anatomical Studies
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with red chalk in another hand
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two limbs, specifically an arm and a leg. On the left, there is a detailed sketch of a muscular arm extending downward, with a bent elbow and a hand with fingers slightly curled. The right side of the image features a detailed sketch of a leg extending downward with attention to musculature and toes pointed downward. The drawing is executed with fine, dark lines, showcasing intricate anatomical details. Shadows and form are suggested through the use of cross-hatching. The backdrop consists of a simple, textured paper. Touches of red chalk appear on the right side.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.creditLine: Julius S. Held Collection, Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a full-length female figure. The woman is shown standing with a slight lean, her right leg bent at the knee. Her head is inclined to the side with closed lips. She has long hair flowing past her shoulders. The drawing does not include clothing, and the background is plain white. No jewelry or objects are shown in the sketch.
